braco.texto: Participants will receive a 2.5 mg/kg of JNJ-64179375 or highest tolerable dose if lower than 2.5 mg/kg followed by administration of a single IV 50 International Unit per kilogram (IU/Kg) dose of a 4 factor prothrombin complex concentrate (PCC) or matching placebo on Day 1.
